name: textarea
props: Rests on the first line, floats onto the border on focus.
Set to false to put the label above the field as static text (no notch); placeholder shows inside.
14 / 16 / 18px text; line height and padding scale too.
Grows smoothly between these, then scrolls.
false makes the limit soft: typing past it turns the counter red and negative.
Counter that becomes a ring in the last 20%.
Row inside the bottom edge — attach, emoji, send.
Red state, icon + message that slides in, one shake.
Green border + animated check; a string is shown as the message.
Colour behind the field (paints the label notch).
Style for the outer wrapper around the field and footer (the one that shakes).

The bordered box: background, border width / colour, radius, height, padding. Wins over the computed style; a borderColor replaces the resting border only (focus, error and success colours still show). height is ignored: the box grows with minRows / maxRows.
The typed text — fontSize, lineHeight, fontWeight, color, fontFamily. Row height follows lineHeight (or scales with fontSize).

Label in both modes (floating and above). color is the resting colour — focus (accent), error and success still take over; fontSize sets the resting size, it floats at the same ratio and the notch follows its width.
Helper / error / success text. color applies to the helper; error and success keep their tone colour.
Counter text (42/280 and the characters-left number); warning / danger still win near the limit.
